add_elemental_features_to_dataframe: add elemental property features to a pandas DataFrame from a chemical composition column using matminer
parse_compositions_and_extract_mean_prop: parse string compositions into pymatgen objects and extract weighted mean elemental properties like electronegativity and atomic mass
featurize_xrf_composition_column: featurize an XRF composition column with periodic table properties including row, group, and mendeleev number
clean_and_join_feature_columns: clean generated feature columns by removing constant and NaN columns then join back to the original DataFrame
review_add_el_features_function: review the add_el_features function that uses matminer ElementProperty to extract weighted mean elemental features from composition strings
